createSite.label: Create a Site
createSite.description: Adds a website to the workspace and returns its tracking snippet details.

getSite.label: Get a Site
getSite.description: Gets one site by its ID, with its settings and tracking details.

createGoal.label: Create a Goal
createGoal.description: Creates a conversion goal on a site. Goals count matching events across all existing history at once.

createChartNote.label: Create a Chart Note
createChartNote.description: Adds a note (annotation) to a site's charts, such as a deploy, a campaign launch or an outage.

createWorkspaceChartNote.label: Create a Workspace Chart Note
createWorkspaceChartNote.description: Adds a note to the charts of every site in the workspace, such as a release that touched them all.

createCampaignLink.label: Create a Campaign Link
createCampaignLink.description: Saves a tagged campaign link (with UTM parameters) in the campaign URL builder and returns the full URL.

addCampaignCost.label: Add a Campaign Cost
addCampaignCost.description: Records what a campaign cost in a month, for cost per acquisition and return on ad spend (Business plan).

createUptimeCheck.label: Create an Uptime Check
createUptimeCheck.description: Starts monitoring a URL, a keyword on a page, a TCP port or a DNS name for a site.

pauseUptimeCheck.label: Pause an Uptime Check
pauseUptimeCheck.description: Pauses an uptime check, for example during planned maintenance.

acknowledgeAlert.label: Acknowledge an Alert
acknowledgeAlert.description: Acknowledges an alert rule's open incident, so the team knows someone is on it.

muteAlert.label: Mute an Alert
muteAlert.description: Silences the notifications of an alert rule for a number of minutes. It keeps recording incidents.

postStatusPageUpdate.label: Post a Status Page Update
postStatusPageUpdate.description: Publishes an incident update on a status page and, by default, emails the page's subscribers.

createExport.label: Create an Export
createExport.description: Queues a data export (CSV, JSON, XLSX, NDJSON or a ZIP of dashboard panels). Use the Watch Export Ready module to act when its file is ready.

inviteMember.label: Invite Members
inviteMember.description: Invites people to the workspace by email. Each gets an invitation link valid for 14 days.

runSiteAudit.label: Run a Site Audit
runSiteAudit.description: Starts an SEO audit of a site now. Use the Watch Site Audit Completed module to act on the result.

startExperiment.label: Start an Experiment
startExperiment.description: Starts an A/B or split URL experiment.

pauseExperiment.label: Pause an Experiment
pauseExperiment.description: Pauses an A/B or split URL experiment.

endExperiment.label: End an Experiment
endExperiment.description: Ends an A/B or split URL experiment.

getTestimonial.label: Get a Testimonial
getTestimonial.description: Gets one testimonial with everything about it, such as the person, the media and the tags.

createTestimonial.label: Create a Testimonial
createTestimonial.description: Adds a text testimonial, for example from a review, a support chat or a survey reply. It counts toward the plan's monthly testimonials.

updateTestimonial.label: Update a Testimonial
updateTestimonial.description: Changes a testimonial: its words, rating, tags, custom properties and more. Only the fields filled in are changed.

approveTestimonial.label: Approve a Testimonial
approveTestimonial.description: Approves a testimonial, so it can be shown on walls and widgets.

pendTestimonial.label: Return a Testimonial to Pending
pendTestimonial.description: Returns a testimonial to pending, so it is not shown until it is approved again.

pinTestimonial.label: Pin or Unpin a Testimonial
pinTestimonial.description: Pins a testimonial so it is shown first, or unpins it.

createTestimonialPerson.label: Create a Testimonial Person
createTestimonialPerson.description: Adds a person (a customer who gives testimonials) to a site.

askForTestimonial.label: Ask for a Testimonial
askForTestimonial.description: Adds a person to a testimonial request. In a running request they get the first email at once, in a draft they wait for it to be sent. Request emails need the Business plan and a connected email provider.

getLiveVisitors.label: Get Live Visitors
getLiveVisitors.description: Gets how many visitors are on a site right now (the last 5 minutes) and what they are doing, from the last 30 minutes.

getSiteStats.label: Get Site Stats
getSiteStats.description: Gets the visitors, visits, pageviews, bounce rate, visit duration and revenue of a site for a period, optionally compared with the previous one.

searchSites.label: Search Sites
searchSites.description: Searches the sites of the workspace by domain or name.

searchGoals.label: Search Goals
searchGoals.description: Searches the goals of a site, with completions, conversions, rate and value for a period.

searchChartNotes.label: Search Chart Notes
searchChartNotes.description: Searches the chart notes of a site.

searchAlertRules.label: Search Alert Rules
searchAlertRules.description: Searches the alert rules of the workspace, with their state (ok or triggered).

searchAlertIncidents.label: Search Alert Incidents
searchAlertIncidents.description: Searches the incidents of one alert rule, newest first.

searchUptimeChecks.label: Search Uptime Checks
searchUptimeChecks.description: Searches the uptime checks of a site, with status and uptime.

searchExperiments.label: Search Experiments
searchExperiments.description: Searches the experiments of a site, with status, variants and results.

searchSiteAudits.label: Search Site Audits
searchSiteAudits.description: Searches the SEO audits of a site, newest first, with score, pages crawled and issues found and fixed.

searchExports.label: Search Exports
searchExports.description: Searches the data exports of the workspace.

searchMembers.label: Search Members
searchMembers.description: Searches the members of the workspace by email or name, with their role.

searchTestimonials.label: Search Testimonials
searchTestimonials.description: Searches the testimonials of a site by their words, the person, rating, status, tags and more.

searchTestimonialPeople.label: Search Testimonial People
searchTestimonialPeople.description: Searches the people of a site (customers who give testimonials) by email or name.

searchTestimonialForms.label: Search Testimonial Forms
searchTestimonialForms.description: Searches the testimonial forms of a site.

searchTestimonialRequests.label: Search Testimonial Requests
searchTestimonialRequests.description: Searches the testimonial requests of a site.

searchTopValues.label: Search Top Values
searchTopValues.description: Ranks the top values of one report (pages, referrers, campaigns, countries, devices, events, goals and more) for a period, one row per bundle.

searchDailyStats.label: Search Stats Over Time
searchDailyStats.description: Gets the visitors, visits and pageviews of a site for each day (or hour, week or month) of a period, one bucket per bundle.

makeApiCall.label: Make an API Call
makeApiCall.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized API call to the Privatus Analytics API. This module cannot send DELETE requests.

watchAlertTriggered.label: Watch Alert Triggered
watchAlertTriggered.description: Triggers when an alert rule fires: a traffic threshold, a spike or drop, a goal, a new referrer, no data, usage and more. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchAlertResolved.label: Watch Alert Resolved
watchAlertResolved.description: Triggers when an alert rule recovers. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchGoalAlertTriggered.label: Watch Goal Alert Triggered
watchGoalAlertTriggered.description: Triggers when a goal alert rule fires (a goal reached, or fell under, its number of completions). Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchUsageThreshold.label: Watch Usage Threshold Reached
watchUsageThreshold.description: Triggers when a usage alert fires because the workspace's monthly events passed a share of the plan's allowance. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchUptimeDown.label: Watch Uptime Check Down
watchUptimeDown.description: Triggers when an uptime check starts failing. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchUptimeUp.label: Watch Uptime Check Recovered
watchUptimeUp.description: Triggers when a failing uptime check is back up. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchSiteCreated.label: Watch New Site
watchSiteCreated.description: Triggers when a site is added to the workspace. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchSiteDeleted.label: Watch Site Deleted
watchSiteDeleted.description: Triggers when a site is deleted from the workspace. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchMemberAdded.label: Watch New Member
watchMemberAdded.description: Triggers when someone joins the workspace (an accepted invitation, single sign-on or SCIM). Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchExportReady.label: Watch Export Ready
watchExportReady.description: Triggers when an export has finished and its file is ready to download. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchImportCompleted.label: Watch Analytics Import Completed
watchImportCompleted.description: Triggers when an import of analytics history (from Google Analytics or a file) finishes. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchImportFailed.label: Watch Analytics Import Failed
watchImportFailed.description: Triggers when an import of analytics history fails. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchSiteAuditCompleted.label: Watch Site Audit Completed
watchSiteAuditCompleted.description: Triggers when an SEO site audit finishes, with its score and the issues found and fixed. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchExperimentEnded.label: Watch Experiment Ended
watchExperimentEnded.description: Triggers when an A/B or split URL experiment ends, with or without a winner, with the results of every variant. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialReceived.label: Watch New Testimonial
watchTestimonialReceived.description: Triggers when a testimonial arrives through a form, a request, the API, the browser extension or by hand. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialApproved.label: Watch Testimonial Approved
watchTestimonialApproved.description: Triggers when a testimonial is approved, so it can be shown on walls and widgets. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialRejected.label: Watch Testimonial Rejected
watchTestimonialRejected.description: Triggers when a testimonial is rejected. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialRestored.label: Watch Testimonial Restored
watchTestimonialRestored.description: Triggers when a testimonial is restored from the trash. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialTrashed.label: Watch Testimonial Moved to Trash
watchTestimonialTrashed.description: Triggers when a testimonial is moved to the trash. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialDeleted.label: Watch Testimonial Deleted
watchTestimonialDeleted.description: Triggers when a testimonial is deleted permanently, by a person or when the trash is emptied. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialFormSubmitted.label: Watch Testimonial Form Submitted
watchTestimonialFormSubmitted.description: Triggers when someone completes a testimonial form, whether it became a testimonial or private feedback. Never includes their email address. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialRequestSent.label: Watch Testimonial Request Sent
watchTestimonialRequestSent.description: Triggers when the first emails of a testimonial request go out. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialRequestCompleted.label: Watch Testimonial Request Finished
watchTestimonialRequestCompleted.description: Triggers when a testimonial request finishes: every person replied, opted out or got every email. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialImportFinished.label: Watch Testimonial Import Finished
watchTestimonialImportFinished.description: Triggers when an import of testimonials or reviews finishes reading, or fails. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.

watchTestimonialSyncNewFound.label: Watch New Reviews Found by Sync
watchTestimonialSyncNewFound.description: Triggers when an automatic sync of a review platform stores new reviews. Make creates the webhook in Privatus Analytics for you and removes it when the scenario no longer uses it.
